name: codefriends
description: Steam Friends–style presence + DM popout for people using Cursor, Claude, Codex, and Gemini.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,popout -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @codefriends/server" "npm run dev -w @codefriends/popout"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codefriends/shared && npm run build -w @codefriends/core && npm run build -w @codefriends/server && npm run build -w @codefriends/popout && npm run compile -w codefriends && npm run typecheck -w @codefriends/worker
scripts.test:connect: npm run test -w @codefriends/connect-client && npm run test -w codefriends
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run test:connect
